x1l_boundary_type = reflect
x2r_boundary_type = reflect
x2l_boundary_type = reflect
x3r_boundary_type = reflect
x3l_boundary_type = reflect

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# [Numerics]
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

reconstruct     = ppm        # Options: pcm (1st), MUSCL (2nd), ppm(3rd)
time_integrator = RK3        # Options: RK2, RK3, Euler/RK1

derefine_threshold = 0.10
